claim_scope: Only bounded SyntheticExperimentEvidence from the executed six-cell Gaussian-logistic benchmark, its authorized methods, clean calibration condition, independent clean evaluation, prespecified controls, and reported uncertainty and stability summaries. Any method contrast must be stated cellwise or with an explicitly defined pooled estimand, and the class-conditional alpha/beta parameterization must be reported.
claim_text: Within the specified balanced Gaussian-logistic data-generating process, estimate cellwise differences and uncertainty among uncalibrated logistic regression, temperature scaling, and beta calibration under the authorized symmetric and class-conditional training-label corruption conditions, using clean calibration labels and clean independent evaluation. In this bounded benchmark, post-hoc calibration shows a control-specific degradation at zero noise and improvement in the reported nonzero-noise cells; these patterns are descriptive and conditional on the specified design.
